days.title: Roman History and River Landscapes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Roman amphitheatre
stops.detail: In Brugg and Windisch, at the southern foot of the Jura, you can immerse yourself in the history of two empires from the first few minutes: the Roman amphitheatre, the Vindonissa Legionnaires' path with the only Roman legionnaires' camp in Switzerland and the Habsburg monastery of Königsfelden take you on a journey into the past.

stops.name: Aare
stops.detail: Along the Aare, alluvial zones, secluded bays, wooded islands and sandbanks will delight you.
